action_vi: Tạo canonical reference candidate cho Khiên Gió: một chiếc khiên chiến trường cũ được gió nâng và tự chắn cho đồng đội; quái bảo hộ/cover.
notes: SELF-REFERENCE CANDIDATE ONLY. One battered large old shield as the main body, animated by wind with straps/tassels and a small floating support structure or spirit knot so it reads as an enemy rather than loose equipment. RIGHT-facing defensive lean. Do not turn it into a humanoid armored soldier; keep it visually distinct from Giáp Rỗng and Bamboo Soldier. Child-friendly, full silhouette, transparent RGBA delivery. Candidate/non-canon; no animation rows yet.
